description: Get daily spending totals for a stablecoin over a window. Returns one data point per UTC day with non-zero spending. Amounts are in currency units (26.5 means 26.50), like `get_transactions`.

from.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of an absolute window

period.description: Rolling time window. Mutually exclusive with from/to.

to.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of an absolute window

name: get_daily_spending
